# roxywi_haproxy_config_files (Data Source)

Lists HAProxy configuration files detected by Roxy-WI 9.2 or later. The returned order is the order used by Roxy-WI when validating a multi-file HAProxy configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "roxywi_haproxy_config_files" "example" {
  server_id = 1
}

output "haproxy_config_files" {
  value = data.roxywi_haproxy_config_files.example.files
}

output "haproxy_multiple_files_enabled" {
  value = data.roxywi_haproxy_config_files.example.multiple_files
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (Number) Server ID whose HAProxy configuration files should be listed.

### Read-Only

- `files` (List of String) Ordered HAProxy configuration files returned by Roxy-WI.
- `multiple_files` (Boolean) Whether multiple HAProxy configuration files are enabled for the server.
